preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The size of each array n must be between 5 and 500.
The total sum of n across all test cases must not exceed 500.

postconditions.description: The output must consist of the count of good subsets modulo 998244353 followed by the indices of the good subset.
The number of indices in the good subset must be equal to n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= index <= 2 * n for index in indices)
postconditions.description: All indices in the good subset must be valid indices between 1 and 2n.
